units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 1. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things used as instruments to commit an administrative offence or constituting its objects consists in drawing up an inventory and informing the person subject to that measure securing proceedings, or their legal representative, that disposal of those things (and, where necessary, their use) is prohibited. It shall be applied where seizure is impossible and/or preservation can be ensured without seizure. Things under attachment may be placed in the responsible custody of other persons designated by the official imposing attachment.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 2. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things shall be carried out by the officials specified in Article 27.3 and part 2 of Article 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of the possessor and either in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: In urgent cases, things may be placed under attachment in their possessor’s absence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.14 · “In urgent cases, things may be placed under attachment in their…”

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 3. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 4. An attachment record shall be drawn up specifying the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the person subject to the measure securing proceedings and the person possessing the goods, vehicles and other things attached, their inventory and identifying characteristics, and an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during attachment using those methods shall be attached to the record.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 5. Where necessary, goods, vehicles and other things under attachment shall be packaged and/or sealed.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 6. A copy of the attachment record shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case or their legal representative.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
units.text: 7. If goods, vehicles or other things under attachment are alienated or concealed, the person subject to that measure securing proceedings or the custodian shall be liable under legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.14

units.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 27.14.1

units.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 27.14.1

units.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation by the officials specified in points 8 and 10.1 of part 1 of Article 27.2 of this Code shall be carried out under Article 27.14 of this Code, taking into account this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.14.1

units.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The procedure for storage, upkeep, safe berthing and return of vessels under attachment, and reimbursement to port infrastructure possessors of expenses associated with storage of the vessel and provision for its crew’s subsistence, shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.14.1

units.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. A vessel used as an instrument to commit an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code shall be released immediately after security is deposited under Article 27.18 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.14.1

units.locator: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.text: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.label: Art. 27.15

units.locator: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.label: Art. 27.15

units.locator: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.text: 1. In the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 29.4 and point 8 of part 1 of Article 29.7 of this Code, compulsory appearance shall be applied to an individual or the legal representative of a legal entity against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, the legal representative of a minor being held administratively liable, or a witness.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.15

units.locator: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.text: 2. Compulsory appearance shall be carried out:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.15

units.locator: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.text: 1) by the body authorised to enforce enforcement documents and maintain the established order of court activities, on the basis of a procedural order by the judge or a ruling by an official of that body considering the administrative offence case, in accordance with the procedure established by the federal executive body responsible for regulatory legal governance of maintaining the established order of court activities and enforcement of judicial acts and acts of other bodies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 27.15

units.locator: Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance
units.text: 2) by an internal affairs body (police), on the basis of a procedural order by that body, another body or an official considering the administrative offence case, in accordance with the procedure established by the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 27.15

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.label: Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.label: Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 1. Temporary prohibition of activity consists in a short-term cessation, until the case is considered by a court or the officials specified in points 1 and 4 of part 2 of Article 23.31 of this Code, of the activities of branches, representative offices, structural subdivisions of a legal entity or production sites, the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular activities (works), or the provision of services. It may be applied if the administrative offence may be punished by administrative suspension of activity. It may be applied only in exceptional cases where necessary to prevent an immediate threat to human life or health, an epidemic, an epizootic, infestation (contamination) of objects subject to quarantine by quarantine pests, a radiation accident or an industrial disaster, or substantial harm to the condition or quality of the environment; to eliminate violations consisting in unlawful employment of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation, non-compliance with restrictions on particular activities imposed under federal law on foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations, violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in work at retail markets, or repeated failure to use cash register equipment where required by federal laws; or to prevent further unlawful provision of consumer credits (loans), including those for which the borrower’s obligations are secured by a mortgage; and where those circumstances cannot be prevented by other means.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: Temporary prohibition of activity shall not apply to violations of legislation of the Russian Federation on combating the legalisation (laundering) of criminal proceeds and terrorist financing. Transactions on the accounts of an organisation conducting transactions with money or other property shall be suspended under that legislation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.16 · “Temporary prohibition of activity shall not apply to violations…”

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 2. Temporary prohibition of activity shall be imposed by an official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up a record of an administrative offence punishable by administrative suspension of activity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 3. A temporary prohibition record shall be drawn up specifying the grounds for applying that measure securing proceedings, the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the official drawing it up, information about the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted, the activity object subject to the prohibition, the time activity actually ceased, and explanations of the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal representative of the legal entity.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 4. The temporary prohibition record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal representative of the legal entity. If any of those persons does not sign, the official shall make a corresponding entry in the record.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 5. A copy of the temporary prohibition record shall be handed against a signed receipt to the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal representative of the legal entity.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 6. When temporarily prohibiting activity, the official who drew up the record shall apply seals, seal premises, storage places for goods and other material valuables and cash offices, and take other measures to ensure that the legal entity’s official, the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal entity’s legal representative implements the measures specified in the record that are necessary for the temporary prohibition of activity.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.16

units.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
units.label: Art. 27.17

units.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
units.label: Art. 27.17

units.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 1. Repealed from 1 January 2011. — Federal Law of 23.07.2010 No. 171-FZ.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.17

units.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
units.text: 2. The period of temporary prohibition of activity shall run from the actual cessation of the activities of branches, representative offices, structural subdivisions of a legal entity or production sites, the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular activities (works), or the provision of services.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.17

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.label: Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.label: Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 1. Security for a vessel under attachment consists in the deposit of money with the court selecting that measure securing proceedings by the individual or legal entity against whom a case has been initiated concerning an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code, the shipowner, the insurer or the competent authority of the vessel’s flag state.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 2. Security may be applied to Russian and foreign vessels registered in the Russian Federation or a foreign state and used as an instrument to commit an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 3. Security shall be mandatory for foreign vessels used as an instrument to commit an administrative offence on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code, upon a motion by any person referred to in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 4. A written motion for security for a vessel under attachment shall be sent to the court or official handling the administrative offence case. On receiving it, the official shall immediately, or within three days if further clarification of the circumstances is necessary, send the motion and all case materials to the court authorised to consider the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 5. The court shall decide whether to apply security and determine its amount within no more than ten days from receiving the motion referred to in part 4 of this Article from any person referred to in part 1 of this Article. Where such a motion is received from participants in the proceedings or further clarification of the case circumstances is necessary, except in the cases referred to in part 3 of this Article, the decision period may be extended by no more than fifteen days.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 6. The amount of security shall be determined by the court taking into account the administrative fine specified in the sanction of the applicable article of the Special Part of this Code and/or the following amounts determined on the basis of an expert opinion: the value of the vessel and other instruments used to commit the offence and/or the amount of damage caused by the administrative offence. The circumstances specified in parts 2 and 3 of Article 4.1 of this Code shall be taken into account.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 7. The amount of security may not be less than the damage caused by the administrative offence and the maximum administrative fine specified in the sanction of the applicable article of the Special Part of this Code.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 8. The judge’s decision to apply security shall take the form of a procedural order, which may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 9. Copies of the order applying security shall be given to the official handling the administrative offence case, the person depositing security or their legal representative, the individual or legal entity against whom proceedings are conducted, the legal representative of that legal entity or defence counsel. The procedure for returning security and forfeiting it to the state shall be explained to the person depositing it or their legal representative.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 10. Money constituting security shall be paid into the deposit account of the court selecting that measure securing proceedings. The court shall draw up a record of acceptance of security, a copy of which shall be given to the person depositing it.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 11. The federal executive body responsible for foreign affairs shall immediately notify the diplomatic mission or consular institution of the foreign vessel’s flag state in the Russian Federation of the application of security.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
units.text: 12. If a vessel for which security has been applied as a measure securing proceedings is used to commit an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code, that security shall be forfeited to the state by court decision.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 27.18

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Placement of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions consists in escorting them to the special institutions provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation”, or to specially designated premises of border authorities, and temporarily holding them in such special institutions until compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation, revocation of the administrative expulsion ruling, or amendment of that ruling in the cases provided for by part 1 of Article 30.7 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Holding foreign citizens or stateless persons in special institutions under conditions preventing unauthorised departure shall be applied to ensure enforcement of the ruling imposing compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation issued by the judge or official who considered the administrative offence case, or a decision by a border authority official concerning those persons for administrative offences in the field of protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. A foreign citizen or stateless person shall be placed in a special institution provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation” on the basis of a decision by the head or deputy head of the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs, the head or deputy head of its territorial body, the head or deputy head of the federal executive body responsible for security, or the head or deputy head of a border authority, for a period not exceeding 48 hours, or on the basis of a judge’s ruling.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.1. The period specified in part 3 of this Article may be extended by a judge upon a motion by an authorised official of an internal affairs body or an executive body responsible for security, for the period provided for by part 1 of Article 27.19.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.2. The motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution, provided for by part 3.1 of this Article, shall be submitted to the court at the location of that institution within 48 hours from placement of the foreign citizen or stateless person in it.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.3. The motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article shall be accompanied by documents confirming the circumstances stated in it.
units.label: Part 3.3 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.4. Upon receiving the motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article, the judge shall immediately issue a procedural order setting the time and place of its consideration and decide whether to extend the person’s stay in the special institution for the time necessary to consider the motion.
units.label: Part 3.4 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.5. The motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article shall be considered by a judge within five days from receipt.
units.label: Part 3.5 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.6. In preparation for considering the motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article, matters shall be resolved on which, where necessary, one of the following procedural orders shall be issued:
units.label: Part 3.6 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) summoning the foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom the motion has been submitted;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.6 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) summoning the authorised official of the internal affairs body or executive body responsible for security who submitted the motion;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.6 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) requisitioning, under Article 26.10 of this Code, materials (information) necessary to ensure proper and timely consideration and resolution of the question of extending the person’s stay in the special institution.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3.6 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.7. Following consideration of the motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution, the judge shall issue a procedural order specifying one of the following decisions:
units.label: Part 3.7 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) to extend the period for holding the foreign citizen or stateless person in the special institution;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.7 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) to refuse the motion.
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.7 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.8. A judge’s decision to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution shall take the form of a procedural order specifying the particular period of stay.
units.label: Part 3.8 Art. 27.19
